Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking our initial call earlier. As we run procurement for the Meridian integration, our security and procurement teams have a few deliverables they need to close the purchase order:

- A current subprocessor inventory (CSV or spreadsheet) showing provider name, data categories processed, residency (country), and contract link.
- Completed SIG questionnaire (at least Level 1 answers) or CAIQ export where applicable.
- Target dates for SOC 2 evidence delivery (system description, control evidence PDFs).

Can you confirm what you can deliver and by when? Our legal team also requested a copy of your SLA for review. If it helps, we can run a short 30-minute evidence validation call next week.

Appreciate a short plan so we can queue the vendor review.

Best,

Madeline — thanks for the clear ask and for the call. High level: we can provide a current subprocessor manifest, partial SIG answers (we will mark items that require legal/engineering inputs), and a SOC 2 evidence bundle for the items you flagged. Proposed delivery:

- Subprocessor manifest (CSV) — delivered by 2026-05-27 EOD (attached: redwood_subprocessor_manifest_v2.csv)
- CAIQ / SIG partial answers — initial pass by 2026-06-01 (attached: redwood_sig_partial_answers.docx); final SIG completion by 2026-06-04 after internal review
- SOC 2 evidence bundle — target 2026-06-08 (system description, control screenshots, attestation excerpts)
- SLA/terms — I will share a DocuSign copy for your legal to review by 2026-05-27

If that timeline works we can schedule a 30-minute evidence walkthrough the week of 6/1. To be transparent: a subset of SIG questions require input from our infra team (Rishi) and our marketplace/partner team (Camila) for integrations. Marissa, please weigh in on any contractual redlines Meridian should expect.

Next steps:
- Madeline: confirm that 6/8 SOC evidence is acceptable or flag priority items we should deliver earlier.
- Camila: I’ve looped you for any partner-specific subprocessor clarifications (marketplace connectors).
- Rishi & Marissa: see internal thread below for task breakdown.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz

Folks — forwarding Meridian's request and my reply. I need quick confirmations so we can hit the dates. Action items below (please reply inline with ETA):

1) Legal (Marissa): review the SIG answers docx and flag any vendor or contract disclosures that require legal redlines. Target: review complete by 2026-05-28.

2) Infra/Security (Rishi): I need screenshots and control evidence for the SOC2 items in the attached evidence checklist. Specifically: key rotation procedures, KV cache encryption proof, and runtime isolation diagrams. Can you confirm whether we can produce these by 2026-06-04?

3) Partners/Marketplace (Camila): several items in the manifest reference marketplace partners and cross-region replication. Please annotate the CSV rows with data residency and whether the partner has separate SLA terms. Target: 2026-05-27 EOD.

Notes: Meridian asked for a walkthrough — please block 30 min on my calendar for the week of 6/1; I will propose two time slots once we confirm deliverables. Marissa — once you complete legal redline guidance, I will prepare the DocuSign SLA cover for Meridian legal to sign.

If anyone cannot meet the dates, call me directly. This is priority for the Meridian pilot integration.

Thanks —
Vanessa
